system.description:
Unlike other Chimerstry powers, Truth's Essence reveals the truth to observers, dispelling weaker uses of Chimerstry or Obfuscate of which the user is aware or has reason to suspect. A Ravnos can turn it upon a Nosferatu and reveal his true form to all who watch, or banish an irritating illusion cast by his own childe. The power has no other effects, and appears as a mere failure of the targeted illusion rather than a manifestation of the Ravnos' power.

System: If the Ravnos is aware of (or has good reason to suspect) a use of Chimerstry or Obfuscate, he may use this power by concentrating for a turn. The player spends two blood points and rolls Wits + Subterfuge against a difficulty equal to the target's Manipulation + Subterfuge; one or more successes dispels the power for the scene. Truth's Essence only works on targets who have no more dots in Obfuscate or Chimerstry than the Ravnos has in Chimerstry (generation does not matter). The Storyteller is the final judge of whether the Ravnos has "good reason" to suspect illusions.

Costs 20 Experience Traits to learn.

MET: When aware of or reasonably suspecting an active Chimerstry or Obfuscate power at or below her own Chimerstry rating, spend two Blood Traits and win a Mental Challenge (retest Subterfuge) against the illusionist's Subterfuge to dispel the effect for the remainder of the scene.
system.source: Libellus Sanguinis IV: Thieves in the Night, Book One: Charlatans
